lean.statement:
For every E,iota with [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace R E] [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional R E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [Fintype iota],
{V : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ≥0}
    (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    {eta c eps : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) (hec : eta ≤ c) (hc : c < 1) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (t : ι → ℝ) (omega : ι → ι → ℝ)
    (positionWeight momentumWeight : ι → ℝ) :
    ∃ p q : E → E, ∃ N : E → ℕ,
      Measurable p ∧ Measurable q ∧ Measurable N ∧
      (∀ y, p y + eta • gradient V (p y) = y ∧ ‖q y - p y‖ ≤ eps ∧
        run (gradient V) eta eps y (N y + 1) y =
          some (q y, N y + 1)) ∧
      let a := Real.exp (-h / 2)
      let sigma := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-h))
      let γ := ((stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian E)).prod
        ((Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => stdGaussian E)).prod
          (Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => stdGaussian E)))
      let Φ := fun w : (E × E) × ((E × E) × ((ι → E) × (ι → E))) =>
        let P0 := a • w.1.2 + sigma • w.2.1.1
        let Y0 := fun i => w.1.1 + t i • P0
        let Z0 := fun j => gradient V (q (Y0 j) + Real.sqrt eta • w.2.2.1 j)
        let Y1 := fun i => Y0 i - ∑ j, omega i j • Z0 j
        let Z1 := fun j => gradient V (q (Y1 j) + Real.sqrt eta • w.2.2.2 j)
        (w.1.1 + h • P0 - ∑ j, positionWeight j • Z1 j,
          a • (P0 - ∑ j, momentumWeight j • Z1 j) + sigma • w.2.1.2)
      0 ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-h) ∧
      Measurable Φ ∧ ∃ K : Kernel (E × E) (E × E), IsMarkovKernel K ∧
        ∀ s, K s = γ.map (fun z => Φ (s, z))
approved_definition_context: The finite interpreter run(g,eta,eps,y,fuel,x) returns none at zero fuel; at positive fuel it evaluates g(x), sets next=y-eta*g(x), and returns some(x,1) if ||next-x||<=(1-eta)*eps. Otherwise it recurses at next with one less fuel and adds one to a successful returned query count. All arithmetic is exact real arithmetic.

stdGaussian E is the centered Gaussian probability measure with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the finite product of the indicated probability measures; prod is the product measure. map is measurable pushforward.
A Markov kernel K has a probability measure K(s) at each incoming state s, with measurable dependence on s for every measurable output event. All finite sums range over the entire finite index type.
gradient is the real inner-product gradient, fderiv the real Frechet derivative, and smul scalar multiplication. Arrays t,omega,positionWeight,momentumWeight are deterministic real-valued functions.
